json.title: CSV export crashes on files with unicode names
json.body:
Exporting a report whose name contains non-ASCII characters (e.g. `Résumé Q3`)
crashes with `UnicodeEncodeError`.

Steps:
1. Create a report named `Résumé Q3`
2. Click Export -> CSV
